import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,re,base64
p=Path.cwd(); ids=set(json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); found=[]
def write(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0
root=Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus')
for f in sorted(root.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=f.read_bytes(); h=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for ln,raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  obj=json.loads(raw)
  if obj['mathdb_id'] not in ids: continue
  token=re.search(rb'"statement":\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw).group(1)
  assert json.loads(token)==obj['statement']
  found.append({'id':obj['mathdb_id'],'chunk':str(f),'chunk_sha256':h,'line_one_based':ln,'raw_line_base64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode(),'raw_line_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'newline':raw.endswith(b'\n'),'raw_statement_token_base64':base64.b64encode(token).decode(),'token_sha256':hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),'decoded_utf8_sha256':hashlib.sha256(obj['statement'].encode()).hexdigest(),'object':obj})
  print(obj['mathdb_id'],obj['title'],'\n',obj['statement'],'\nSOURCE',obj['source_url'],'\nREF',obj['references'])
assert len(found)==20
write('original-provenance.json',json.dumps(found,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
